description: This file defines the ShapeFormatInfo class, which provides format information for shapes within the MigraDoc rendering framework, inheriting from FormatInfo and managing shape state indicators such as start, end, complete, and empty conditions.

classes.name: ShapeFormatInfo
classes.description: Provides format state information for shapes, indicating whether shape components are starting, ending, complete, or empty.

methods.name: IsStarting
methods.description: Indicates if the shape's start is complete, based on the Fits property.

methods.name: IsEnding
methods.description: Indicates if the shape's end is complete, based on the Fits property.

methods.name: IsComplete
methods.description: Indicates if the shape is fully complete, based on the Fits property.

methods.name: StartingIsComplete
methods.description: Returns true if the shape's starting section is complete, based on Fits.

methods.name: EndingIsComplete
methods.description: Returns true if the shape's ending section is complete, based on Fits.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the shape is empty, which is the negation of Fits.
